sources.title: Microsoft Foundry Models overview - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: The model catalog in Foundry portal is the hub for discovering and using a wide range of models to build generative AI applications. The model catalog features thousands of models from providers like Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, Cohere, NVIDIA, and Hugging Face, including models that Microsoft trained.

sources.title: AI Models | NVIDIA Developer
sources.snippet: Explore and deploy top AI models built by the community, accelerated by NVIDIA's AI inference platform, and run on NVIDIA-accelerated infrastructure.

sources.title: Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Microsoft Foundry is the enterprise AI platform to build, ground, and govern AI apps and agents at scale. It brings together your full agent lifecycle with open development, built-in intelligence, and consistent security, compliance, and policy controls across every agent.
